data.additional_information:
Job Description – Machine Learning Engineer (Fresher)

Company: Computer Vision Technologies Private Limited (Track3D)
Location: Hyderabad, India
Job Type: Full-time, Onsite

About Track3D
Track3D is building the future of construction monitoring with its Reality Intelligence Platform. By transforming real-time visual data into AI-powered insights, the company helps owners, general contractors, and trade partners track progress, reduce disputes, and improve project outcomes.
Track3D is a fast-growing enterprise SaaS startup working with leading companies in the construction industry.

Role Overview
Track3D is looking for a passionate and skilled Machine Learning Engineer to join its Machine Learning team. The role focuses on:

Object Detection
Image Segmentation
3D Reconstruction

The ideal candidate should have strong technical skills, a proactive research mindset, and enthusiasm for learning the latest advancements in Computer Vision. Experience with construction-related projects or real-world deployments is an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities
Design and implement models for object detection, semantic/instance segmentation, and 3D reconstruction.
Analyze and debug large-scale computer vision pipelines.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into production systems.
Conduct research and experiments to evaluate new methods and improve existing workflows.
Understand, enhance, and maintain existing codebases with clean and efficient code.
Communicate technical findings effectively with both technical and non-technical teams.

Required Skills
Experience in Machine Learning and Computer Vision.
Strong programming skills in Python.
Hands-on experience with:
PyTorch
TensorFlow
OpenCV
NumPy
Knowledge of object detection and image segmentation techniques.
Understanding of 3D Vision concepts such as:
Structure from Motion (SfM)
Multi-View Stereo (MVS)
SLAM
COLMAP
Strong debugging and problem-solving abilities.
Positive attitude with a willingness to learn and adapt.
Good written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications
Exposure to construction technology or datasets such as aerial, spherical, or 360° imagery.
Experience with large-scale data processing and pipeline optimization.
GitHub contributions, research publications, or open-source Computer Vision projects.
Experience with Git and collaborative software development practices.

Why Join Track3D?
Work with a high-growth AI-powered SaaS startup.
Build and deploy real-world Machine Learning solutions.
Work on cutting-edge Computer Vision and AI technologies.
Own end-to-end ML systems from research to deployment.
Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Leadership teams.
Make a direct impact on product performance and customer success.

Work Location: Hyderabad (Onsite)
Employment Type: Full-time
